about.title: Writing cheques safely
about.p1: Rules differ by bank and country. Always follow your bank’s instructions.
about.p2: English amounts on cheques often end with “Only”. Hong Kong Chinese uses formal uppercase characters (大寫).
about.p3: Never leave large gaps before the amount in figures or words. Use the full currency name your bank expects.
